Test-only upstream artifacts:
- kosync-verify.mjs: unmodified BSD-3-Clause verifier from https://github.com/pid1/kosync-conformance; commit in kosync-commit.txt; license in LICENSE-kosync.
- opds/: schemas from https://github.com/opds-community/specs.
- readium/: schemas and license from https://github.com/readium/webpub-manifest.
- Schema commit IDs are in opds-commit.txt and readium-commit.txt.
- koreader/: pinned, unmodified AGPL-3.0 Lua source for native client compatibility tests; see its README/COPYING. No KOReader code is bundled into the app.
- Reference Hono implementations were consulted for behavior, not copied into this Effect app.
